name: zanbeel-vcs
description: Run the Zanbeel fox CLI from any VS Code terminal, without installing it per machine.

zanbeel.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Zanbeel server this workspace talks to, for example `https://192.168.15.207:8090`. Exported as `FOXNEST_SERVER`, so it overrides the origin stored in the repository. Leave blank to use whatever the repository is already configured with; **Zanbeel: Sign In** fills it in.

zanbeel.caCertificate.markdownDescription: Certificate file (PEM) to trust for the Zanbeel server, besides the usual public certificate authorities. Leave blank to use the server certificate bundled with this extension. Set it when the server's certificate has been replaced: download the new one from `<server>/zanbeel.crt`.

zanbeel.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Interpreter used to run the bundled CLI. Leave blank to detect automatically (`py -3.11`, `py -3`, `python3`, `python`).

zanbeel.injectPath.markdownDescription: Add `fox` to the `PATH` of terminals VS Code opens. This is what makes `fox` work in the integrated terminal without a system-wide install. Only VS Code's own terminals are affected.

zanbeel.injectToken.markdownDescription:
Export the signed-in token as `FOXNEST_TOKEN` to VS Code terminals. The token is held in the OS keychain rather than written to `~/.foxnest/credentials.json` in the clear.

**Note:** any process started from a VS Code terminal can read this variable.

zanbeel.showStatusBar.description: Show the current Zanbeel branch in the status bar.
